candidates.description: This feature vector activates strongly for characters and subword tokens in the Devanagari script used for Hindi and related languages.
The tokens represent common character sequences, syllables, and sub-word units from the Hindi language written in the Devanagari script.
This vector activates for Indic script characters, diacritics, and specific Unicode symbols related to South Asian text encodings.
This vector represents Hindi vowel signs and dependent vowel diacritics attached to consonants.
This vector represents Devanagari script characters and sub-word units used in Hindi and Sanskrit text.
This feature vector activates strongly on common Hindi characters, sub-word tokens, and the English pronoun "I".
This vector represents common Hindi suffixes, consonant clusters, and postpositional endings.
This feature vector activates on common Hindi sub-word suffixes and consonant conjuncts.
These tokens represent common Hindi vowel signs, matras, and nasalization marks used in the Devanagari script alongside Latin nasal and vowel suffixes.
These tokens represent Devanagari vowel sign modifiers attached to punctuation marks or hyphens.
